@zxdavb Please reframe from merging without somebody looking at it / approving it. Even with simple changes.

Furthermore, considering this fixes a bug, should it have been marked for a patch release milestone?

> Please reframe from merging without somebody looking at it / approving it. Even with simple changes.

I am sorry - I don't know why I have merge permission if I shouldn't/can't use it (notwithstanding I've made two stupid mistakes in a row now) - I thought the idea is to take some workload off the core devs. I will not merge anything again.

In fact, I'd rather not have merge permission at all - could it be removed from me please? At least that way, I won't accidentally push the wrong button.

> Furthermore, considering this fixes a bug, should it have been marked for a patch release milestone?

No need. It is a minor bug of some months ago - I would have fixed it earlier but hadn't I felt it necessary.; it is apparent only rarely, and is an issue only in that the room temp may be 128C instead of None. IMO, there is no rush to have it anywhere other than dev.
You have those rights, so you can, for example, tag milestones, manage issues, but also being able to help out on other PRs that are open for your follow contributors.
